Both p-values render as 0.0000 on the report and the dashboard, which reads as exactly zero; the true p is below 0.0001 at z 26.72 and t 42.70.

On the dashboard the test cards put the p-value under the key 'value' with a label such as 'Test Channel Completion' and nothing marking it as a p, so a reader of the card cannot tell the 0.0000 is a p-value.

The completion-rate caveat 'one quarter of orders in this channel' is the only statement that the denominator is the whole channel, and on the report it is contradicted by the page-level 'delivered only' population line.

Welch t and Cohen's d for H-CHANNEL-AOV could only be approximated from the rounded Student intervals (t 42.62 vs 42.70, d 0.4854 vs 0.4869, within 0.3%); an exact recomputation needs the clean table, which is outside this stage's inputs.
